costReporting.actual: provider-confirmed spend written to campaign_runs.actual_cost (0006 grant) after the window closes; NULL until confirmed, never zero-guessed
costReporting.estimate: hardening_estimate_cost(audience_size, unit_cost) before activation; stored on campaign_runs.estimated_cost; NULL rate reports unset, never zero
costReporting.rateCard: campaign_cost_rates (one row per channel, NGN unit cost; NULL = unset until procurement I4)

dedupe.decision: branch_admin records merged | kept_separate with reason on person_duplicate_reviews; terminal states require decided_by + decision_reason (CHECK); merging itself is a reviewed migrator step, never an app write
dedupe.warning: phone-identity hash match creates a pending person_duplicate_reviews row; the branch admin sees the warning on the person record before any merge

endpointChecks.scope: area_admin, super_admin (full); branch_admin (own branch slice); Telegram alert on anomaly carries ids + counts only, never message content

monitoringChecks.action: GET /api/hardening/status; expect 200 with per-route shape; failure two polls running = endpoint_health red + Telegram alert
monitoringChecks.name: Endpoint health

monitoringChecks.action: confirm the campaign tick + retention pass ran inside their windows (latest campaign_runs.window_start / retention_runs.started_at); a missed window = schedule_health red
monitoringChecks.name: Schedule health

monitoringChecks.action: count campaign_enrollments state = active with next_step_at <= now (due but unprocessed); above the threshold = queue_depth red (tick falling behind)
monitoringChecks.name: Queue depth

monitoringChecks.action: hardening_tick_slo_met(window_at, began_at) per completed run; the share meeting the SLO must stay >= 99%; below = tick_slo red + Telegram alert
monitoringChecks.name: Tick SLO (due step begins within 5 min of window, 99%)

monitoringChecks.action: confirm every campaign_runs.excluded_reasons key and every retention_run_items.skip_reason is in the allowlisted set; an unreasoned exclusion = exclusions_audit red
monitoringChecks.name: Exclusions-by-reason audit
Pause drill (US-C5)
monitoringChecks.action: set one campaign paused (or one channel disabled); assert campaign_due_enrollments excludes its rows on the very next tick; resume; log pause_drill

name: hardening_monitoring
notes: No new service, secret, or dependency: checks read tables this slice owns plus the sibling run tables; alerting reuses the Telegram path from integrations-addendum section 7.

Pause drill (US-C5): setting campaigns.status = paused (or communication_channels.enabled = false) must remove enrollments from campaign_due_enrollments on the very next tick; the drill asserts this and logs pause_drill.
Every check writes one hardening_monitor_checks row (ok + detail with ids/counts only); the alert reads the latest row per key, never the delivery log.

telegramAlert.never: message content, contact values, rendered text
telegramAlert.on: any check red, daily_cap exceeded, failure-rate spike, volume spike
